When it's hot we tend to allow the heat to get to us, make us uncomfortable and unable to relax. Ajahn asked us to not only let go any noise around us but the heat as well. Ajahn then lead the group in a 30 minute body scan meditation well suited to beginners and experienced a like. After meditation Ajahn opened to Q&A.
